result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\. Both offer business-focused password sharing, centralized administration, and secure employee offboarding.

My overall pick depends on whether you prioritize ease of use or value.

## Best password managers for small teams

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password Business** (Best overall experience)

**Best for\:** Teams that want simplicity and excellent usability.

- Shared vaults for departments and projects
- Granular access permissions
- Admin controls and activity reports
- Easy onboarding and offboarding
- Security alerts and password health monitoring

Business: approximately \$8.99/user/month. Teams Starter Pack: \$24.95/month for up to 10 users.

[1Password Business website](https://1password.com/business)

---

![‎Bitwarden App - App Store](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/x38pyi5v1Vy6Zs97qz8ZgS0U3TY6bP46EZUol0vjWY-QJEsjpBL1sBYpo0AxExRZj59SXzc9D5J1hCMKpLCQRKtRmi0IYkc0CeiDQsrny4xPWuRz2OGsqZ9tyuMm4GtN5vMAwBBf6hXgHDHMP9_wXSBVttW9bXO5pQrWG4hhS-RxRNQIRTsbPrqb3y45Jv-M?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden Teams**

(Best value)

**Best for\:** Budget-conscious teams that still want strong security.

- Shared collections and passwords
- User and group management
- Audit and event logs
- Open-source software
- Cross-platform support

Teams: approximately \$4/user/month, billed annually.

[Bitwarden Business website](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper Business**

**Best for\:** Small businesses wanting straightforward administration.

- Shared team folders
- Role-based permissions
- Admin console
- Security reporting
- Secure credential sharing

Business Starter: approximately \$2/user/month for eligible small teams, billed annually.

[Keeper Business website](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![Test Dashlane : un gestionnaire de mots de passe élégant et complet, mais trop avare - Les Numériques](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/66TJUMmYmc2uHzIsxHHiAx7hxRQ8alP8a248IQqZpKMw5qyY_k9MeFr4rutufsLjTYxUl32XmJycQKSNVtCaRTxRhBdFKuuN8SD7uZ8vs9JkSCZSzdZ2yIQm88TGjWCrg-h07fJdRP7X6VdOalsZe2e6fj_Ou1dMYyLIEbt_d4hajtzL8hVlKJz2qWk0Hm2z?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Dashlane Business**

**Best for\:** Businesses wanting additional credential-risk monitoring.

- Password health monitoring
- Security alerts
- Centralized administration
- Secure password sharing

Business pricing varies by offering.

[Dashlane Business website](https://www.dashlane.com/business)

## My comparison

| Feature | 1Password | Bitwarden | Keeper |
|--------|--------|--------|--------|
| Ease of use | Excellent | Very good | Very good |
| Shared passwords | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Admin controls | Excellent | Very good | Very good |
| Audit logs | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Budget friendly | Moderate | Excellent | Excellent |
| Best for | Usability | Value | Administration |


Prices and feature availability depend on the subscription tier. Figures above are approximate November 2026 pricing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I'd choose

- **2–10 employees\:** 1Password Teams Starter Pack.
- **10–30 employees\:** Bitwarden Teams.
- **Growing business with more complex permissions\:** 1Password Business.

Whichever you choose, I'd make sure you have\:

- Mandatory two-factor authentication.
- Separate vaults for departments.
- Individual employee accounts (never shared master accounts).
- An offboarding process that revokes access immediately.
- A policy against storing passwords in spreadsheets or chat messages.

## One question to narrow it down

**How many people are on your team?**

That will help me recommend the best plan and avoid having you pay for enterprise features you don't need.
